name: Palmont Family Office
decision_note: Single-family office of Petr Kellner Jr. (Prague, est. 2025) investing proceeds from his PPF stake, e.g. the Tonak acquisition and an October 2026 commitment to the Spinoffy fund - a family office, outside the VC pilot.

evidence.quote: Rodinná kancelář Palmont Petra Kellnera mladšího nově podpořila fond Spinoffy.
Nově se pak do tohoto výčtu zapojila i Palmont Family Office Petra Kellnera mladšího, jenž loni prodal svůj podíl v PPF a inkasovaných více než čtyřicet miliard korun začal investovat.
A podobné projekty nově podporuje také Palmont Family Office, za kterou stojí Petr Kellner mladší.

analyst_notes: Second-pass screen (named as an LP of Spinoffy). Type is plain: CzechCrunch calls it the family office (rodinná kancelář) of Petr Kellner Jr., funded by his PPF exit (over CZK 40bn); investments named in the article are an LP commitment to Spinoffy (2026-10-14) and the acquisition of the hat maker Tonak - so S1. The Spinoffy commitment is an LP commitment to a third-party fund, not recorded in 'funds' (that field is for the investor's own vehicles). Legal entities: Palmont a.s., Palmont Holding s.r.o., Palmont Investment s.r.o. (all Řetězová 6, Praha 1, registered Nov 2025; further Palmont Real Estate/Heritage/Facility companies exist) - which one holds which stake was not established. Investment director per the article: Adam Páleníček. No website found; no web search left to look for one.
